propositions: Completion verifier blocks close when acceptance criteria no longer match reality, with no documented legitimate path forward other than --force-close (unsigned) or --ref to old commit (leaves inaccurate state)
When acceptance criteria are invalidated by the fix itself, no commit reference exists where both the fix is present and criteria remain satisfiable
Auto-generated or unverifiable acceptance criteria cannot be satisfied at any commit reference, stranding completion verification
Plan-review close gate's stale-regver check forces re-review of already-executed plans when criteria registry changes, blocking closure of genuinely complete work
Documented solution for criteria invalidated by subsequent work is to close with --ref at landing commit where criteria were satisfiable
